ValidationRule.description: No se pueden modificar los campos Alert Name, Alert ID, Start Date o End Date
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator") ), OR( $RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Commercial_Task', $RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Commercial_Task_No_Auth' ), OR( ISCHANGED(Name), ISCHANGED(almd__commercial_alert_id__c), ISCHANGED(almd__commercial_alert_start_date__c), ISCHANGED(almd__commercial_alert_end_date__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Insufficient privileges to edit Alert Name, Alert ID, Start Date and End Date.
